title: Accelerating Multimodal Large Language Models via Dynamic Visual-Token Exit and the Empirical Findings
paper_observation: Section 3 reports dropping all visual tokens at layer 24 on GQA gives 0.5% / 0.6% performance drop for LLaVA-1.5 7B / 13B. Figure 3 is fixed layer removal; dynamic router results are a separate protocol.
comparison_caveat: Our upstream-filtered 240-image left/right candidate joint-logP evaluation with no KV cache is not full-benchmark generated-answer GQA evaluation, nor trained DyVTE. No direct numerical reproduction claim.
